messages.subject: Licensing Helmsman to a major retailer — can you act?
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Good to catch up yesterday. As discussed, we've had serious inbound from Wexbourne Retail Group about licensing the Helmsman platform across their fulfilment estate (Daventry, Lutterworth, Peterborough). This is our first big out-licence so we want it done properly — patent grant, exclusivity in their retail field, the lot.

Can Whitfield Carter act for us? Aisha will be the technical point of contact. We'd like to move quickly; they want a pilot live by the end of January.

Marcus

messages.subject: RE: Licensing Helmsman to a major retailer — can you act?
messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Delighted to act — congratulations, this is a great milestone for Penrose. James Osei will run the day-to-day with Elena Marchetti supporting; I'll stay close as supervising partner. We'll use the codename "Project Zephyr" in all correspondence.

First steps: a mutual NDA before any technical detail changes hands, then a short term sheet to pin the commercials. I'll send an engagement letter today. We should also line up Hartington IP for a freedom-to-operate view given this is patent-heavy.

Sarah

Sarah Whitfield
Partner | Corporate & Technology
Whitfield Carter LLP
T +44 (0)20 7946 0512

This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
